Thanks TJ — great to meet you (virtually).

We can do Dec 7 at 9:00am PT for the 90-minute kickoff. I've looped in Laura (implementation lead), Ben (SRE liaison), and Monica (CS ops) who will run post-kickoff handoffs.

Attached is our short pre-kick checklist (obs_prekick-checklist.pdf). Key asks on our side:
- Service list + owners (CSV)
- Top 3 latency-sensitive endpoints
- Any HIPAA/PII considerations for traces or logs
- Link to a staging dashboard you want mirrored (if any)

On the kickoff we'll cover: introductions, topology/permissions, runbook inventory, initial dashboard mapping, tracing-hook placement, and alert routing decisions. Post-kick we'll ship a mutual action plan with milestones and an initial runbook matrix.

Please confirm the attendee list and whether the Clearsight SREs can share a short runbook export (even a csv) ahead of time — that will save time.

Agenda + calendar invite to follow.

Best,

TJ / team — great, thanks for sharing the staging targets. A few quick notes in advance of the kickoff:

- Runbook inventory: if you can share the CSV schema we typically map these fields into our runbook matrix (owner, severity, runbook link, recovery steps, playbook id). I attached an example mapping and the template we use.

- Tracing hooks: we recommend instrumenting at the API gateway and the principal downstream services (auth, billing, model-serving). We'll bring a short trace-injection plan to the kickoff and mark low-risk insertion points for your SREs.

- Error taxonomy: attached is a starter taxonomy we use: user_errors (4xx), transient_errors (5xx, retry), infrastructure_errors (node OOM, disk), data_errors (schema mismatch). Please flag any Clearsight-specific categories.

- Dashboards: for the three Grafana dashboards you listed we'll propose a first-pass mapping (what to mirror vs what we'll rebuild in Redwood Console for observability ergonomics).

I'll attach the runbook template and taxonomy. Looking forward to the kickoff.

--
Laura Bennett
Principal Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: runbook_inventory.csv (template), obs_error-taxonomy.md

TJ — thanks for confirming. I've drafted a mutual action plan (MAP) and a short milestone schedule; sending as attachment. Highlights:

1) Kickoff (Dec 7, 9:00am PT) — goals: runbook export review, dashboard mapping, trace-hook plan, alert routing decision.
2) Week 1 post-kick: permissions + staging dashboard mirror + first traceroute proof-of-concept.
3) Week 2: runbook imports and initial alert routing to PD + Slack; define SLOs for top 3 endpoints.
4) Week 3: ratify runbooks, confirm fallback policy (regional failover to Redwood-hosted model variant).

Action items for Clearsight before kickoff:
- Share runbook_inventory.csv (or equivalent)
- Confirm staging Grafana links
- List of PagerDuty services and the Slack channel names for alert routing

I've uploaded the MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and created a shared Drive folder with the checklist and runbook template. Also added a DocuSign envelope in case procurement wants the MAP signed for billing/commit milestones.

See the calendar invite (Dec 7 — Redwood / Clearsight Observability Kickoff).

Monica
